headline: Front-Line Fortunes Shift Across Six Sectors
war_summary: The latest returns show the front still in motion, though the pattern has altered since the previous edition. WeatheredExpanseHex remains the storm centre with forty-two strategic-base events in the past day, five in the latest two hours; its ledger now stands at four Warden and five Colonial bases, with no neutral holdings reported. PalantineBermHex has risen to thirteen daily events and two in the latest two hours, while MooringCountyHex records ten for the day and two recently, its balance now ten Warden to two Colonial bases. StlicanShelfHex has seen four events in the latest two hours and ten across the day, with four Warden and five Colonial bases. CallahansPassageHex reports seven daily events, three in six hours, and continues to carry the heaviest casualty totals among the recently active sectors. FishermansRowHex, previously quiet in the supplied edition, has registered five events in the latest two hours; two Warden and seven Colonial bases remain on its books. Elsewhere, most regions show no strategic-base movement in the latest day.
